Include a bounded external check of the published capability envelope for comparably sized local models.

question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints (huggingface.co resolve-redirect GGUF download; llama.cpp constrained decoding; CPU-only nproc=4; no human-issued credential; no paid endpoint), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification the parent harness did not have; parent-style prompt as the grand-parent harness's SYS prompt did) convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full multi-step click-then-answer completion (click #reveal-btn, then answer TARGET-42) for the largest obtainable credential-free models (M-7B-QWEN primary, M-3B-QWEN second, M-14B-QWEN escalation) -- and if not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory {E-LOCAL-LLAMA local GGUF range: 0.5B(carried)/3B/7B/14B Qwen2.5; E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI gpt-oss-20b proxy (carried)}? Return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation so that readiness condition (3) is either satisfied by a proven same-model driver or the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is explicitly re-scoped off the credential-free path.
hypothesis: The parent's 0/5 negatives (EXP-INTEL-37982024058) for M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN are caused at least partly by system-prompt underspecification (audit finding VF-01), not by an immutable model-capability ceiling. Under a parent-style system prompt that states the goal ('Click the reveal button to reveal the code, then answer it') and enumerates the action schema ('Actions available: {click/selector} or {answer/text}'), the models' step-0 reveal-click (observed 5/5 in the parent) will convert into a full click-then-answer completion: task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (bar cleared) for at least one candidate in the obtainable set {M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN}, all other frozen constraints held byte-identical to the parent (same GBNF grammar, user template, task HTML, seeds 42-46, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, same GGUF shards, CPU-only).
falsifier: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints with the parent-style goal+schema system prompt, no model in the obtainable set {M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} (plus carried negatives M-0.5B-QWEN-LOCAL and B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY completing the attainable census) clears the frozen capability bar (>=3/5 episodes with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6), while the within-experiment replication arm CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION confirms that the environment/harness is behaviorally continuous with the parent protocol (reproduces 0/5 + reveal-click loop pattern on M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN) and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE confirms the task/verifier can reward a correct click-then-answer (5/5). Exhaustion of the obtainable credential-free model range under identical constraints closes the credential-free external-agent path and licenses the explicit close/re-scope decision that readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfied by any credential-free same-model driver; the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark must be re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3's same-model external anchor; re-anchor on internally re-run comparators with a dynamic-range task bank per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128).

branch_reachability_matrix.SUPPORTS: reachable: any measured candidate clears the bar under PR-SPECIFIED. The treatment reuses the parent's verified load/PC/episode path and verifies completion mechanically (answer text == TARGET-42).
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES: reachable: PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE 5/5, replication PASS, and all of M-7B-QWEN/M-3B-QWEN/M-14B-QWEN measured and failing under PR-SPECIFIED.
branch_reachability_matrix.MIXED: reachable: replication PASS and 7B/3B fail but M-14B-QWEN is NOT attempted or not measured (attainability gate, download error, run error or PC-fail) -> 14B explicitly UNRESOLVED.
branch_reachability_matrix.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: reachable: PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE < 5/5 (task/verifier cannot reward success); PC-JSON fails on both 7B and 3B (decoding infrastructure); a candidate clears under PR-UNDERSPEC or the loop signature is absent in both models (environment not continuous with parent); playwright/chrome/server failure.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.arithmetic_check: The bar is attained with >= 3 of 5 episodes on BOTH metrics (fraction >= 0.6). B-RANDOM-ACTION establishes a near-zero chance floor: only 1 of 5 action-space entries is the correct answer, and it requires the correct preceding click. The ceiling is certified at 1.0 by PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE. Comparator and treatment differ only in the frozen system-prompt string; grammar, HTML, user template, seeds, sampling, model shards, verifier and episode count are byte-identical.

self_attack_findings.finding: The first-drafted freeze_eligibility marked freeze_artifacts_bound PASS against three pre-existing parent files while the actual EXECUTE harness (the true interpretation dependency) cannot pre-exist at DESIGN freeze time (DESIGN scope writes only spec.json/prereg.md).
self_attack_findings.resolution: Reclassified freeze_artifacts_bound to NOT_APPLICABLE with freeze_artifacts=[], mirroring the only accepted v2 precedent (EXP-GRAPH-37992949248). The reused parent fixture/ancestor script are immutable external evidence referenced by path (spec.code_binding); the EXECUTE harness is bound at EXECUTE by sha256 into result.json.artifacts (role 'code') and provenance.json.

self_attack_findings.finding: No control proved the task/verifier can register success: PC-JSON only exercises decoding, NC/B-RANDOM only reject. A universal 0/5 across all candidates would be uninterpretable if the page/verifier never rewarded a correct click-then-answer.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE (non-model scripted policy emits the correct click then answer; requires 5/5). Its failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, so a negative result cannot be an unpassable-task artifact.

self_attack_findings.finding: The 14B RAM precondition was stated as 'free RAM 14 GiB'; actual free RAM is ~10.8 GiB (~14.1 GiB available), so the 14B arm could be silently dropped and a 7B/3B-only negative mislabelled FALSIFIES.
self_attack_findings.resolution: 14B is explicitly attainability-gated against available memory (>= ~11 GiB). Non-attainment yields NOT_ATTEMPTED-RAM and OUTCOME=MIXED with 14B marked UNRESOLVED, never FALSIFIES.

self_attack_findings.finding: The 7B single-file URL 404s; an EXECUTE harness that guesses that URL would record a spurious provisioning failure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: The single-file 404 is recorded as a pre-freeze probe result; EXECUTE uses only the pinned split-shard URLs.

self_attack_findings.finding: The first-drafted FALSIFIES branch implicitly assumed 14B attainment; a run that stopped at 7B/3B could have been over-claimed as a full-census negative.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Decision rule separates FALSIFIES (14B measured and failing) from MIXED (14B unresolved) with an explicit bounded-capability-ceiling statement in each case.

PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.description: A deterministic NON-MODEL scripted policy emits, on episode step 1, {'action':'click','selector':'#reveal-btn'} and, on step 2, {'action':'answer','text':'TARGET-42'}, through the identical episode pipeline (same page server, Playwright/chrome, parser and verifier). 5 episodes.
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.success_criterion: scripted_oracle_task_success_rate == 5/5. Any value < 5/5 => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the task/verifier cannot reward a correct click-then-answer; no candidate negative would be interpretable).
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.why_it_is_a_real_control: It certifies the ceiling (a correct multi-step action sequence is rewarded at 1.0), which no grammar-only positive control can do. Without it, a universal 0/5 cannot be distinguished from an unpassable task.

PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.description: 10/10 probes 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' per candidate model through the identical llama.cpp LlamaGrammar path used for task episodes. Isolates model reasoning from decoding infrastructure.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema, per candidate, before any task episode of that candidate.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.why_it_is_a_real_control: It can fail (a broken grammar/build does), separating constrained-decoding infrastructure from model capability; identical to the parent's passing control.

NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.description: Run the minimal task with a fixed invalid content producer ('I will click the button'), 5 episodes.
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.success_criterion: 0% parseable JSON actions and 0% task completion (reproduction of parent behavior expected).
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.why: Confirms the verification logic correctly rejects non-parseable actions and that completion requires model-driven actions.

task_success_rate.definition: fraction of episodes whose final answer text == 'TARGET-42'

parseable_action_rate_step1.definition: fraction of episodes whose step-1 action parsed to valid schema JSON

answer_action_emission_rate.definition: fraction of episodes emitting >= 1 parseable 'answer' action (the click-then-answer conversion metric named by the mandate)

step0_reveal_click_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with a 'click' on '#reveal-btn' at step 1 (parent observed 5/5)

mean_inference_latency_s.definition: mean per-step inference latency per candidate

mean_completion_tokens.definition: mean per-step completion tokens per candidate

candidate_cleared_bar.definition: derived bool per candidate: >= 3/5 episodes with BOTH parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6

census_completed.definition: derived bool: whether the full obtainable set {0.5B carried, 3B, 7B, 14B, Pollinations proxy carried} is accounted for with measured/attained or explicit NOT_* reason codes

Identical mechanical verification: Playwright (1.63.0) drives system google-chrome (154.0.8037.97) via executable_path; success = answer text == TARGET-42; the button becomes hidden and the target visible after click.

Raw evidence preserved per episode: model load time, inference latency, token usage, raw completion, parsed action, regex-parse fallback, click/answer mechanics, final answer, seed; per-model receipts appended.

decision_rule:
Arms (frozen). Candidate order: M-7B-QWEN -> M-3B-QWEN -> (conditional) M-14B-QWEN. Per candidate: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING (10/10) -> PR-UNDERSPEC (5 episodes; M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN only, as the CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION arm) -> PR-SPECIFIED (5 episodes, treatment). M-14B-QWEN runs only if neither 7B nor 3B cleared the bar, and runs PC then PR-SPECIFIED only (no parent receipt, so no replication arm). PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE runs once, before any model episode.

Bar cleared per candidate iff >= 3/5 episodes have BOTH parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6.

Ordered evaluation (outcome in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MIXED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status in {COMPLETE, BLOCKED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}):
1. If PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE != 5/5 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (task/verifier cannot reward success). If PC-JSON fails on BOTH M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (decoding infrastructure). A candidate whose PC-JSON fails is NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL.
2. Run CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION (7B, 3B under PR-UNDERSPEC). PASS iff each model yields task_success_rate = 0/5 AND >= 4/5 episodes with a step-0/step-1 reveal-click AND >= 1 loop-signature episode (post-reveal hidden-element click or answer-without-reveal with final answer != TARGET-42). If either model CLEARS the bar under PR-UNDERSPEC, or the loop signature is absent in both models => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (environment not continuous with parent; ablation unidentifiable). Raw observations still reported.
3. Run treatment. If any measured candidate clears the bar under PR-SPECIFIED => SUPPORTS (early stop; remaining candidates NOT_ATTEMPTED-EARLY-STOP, never negatives). Readiness condition (3) satisfied by a proven same-model driver.
4. If replication passed and every measured candidate failed under PR-SPECIFIED:
   a. If M-14B-QWEN was attained and measured and failed => FALSIFIES. Demonstrable ceiling = {M-0.5B-QWEN (carried), M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN, B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY (carried)} = the full credential-free endpoint/model set actually available (E-LOCAL-LLAMA range + E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI). Issue the explicit close/re-scope recommendation.
   b. If M-14B-QWEN was NOT attempted or failed attainment/measurement (NOT_ATTEMPTED-RAM / NOT_ATTEMPTED-URL / NOT_ATTEMPTED-DISK / NOT_MEASURED-RUN-ERROR / NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL) => MIXED. Negative bounded strictly to the measured set {0.5B carried, 3B, 7B} + carried proxy; 14B explicitly UNRESOLVED; close/re-scope recommendation issued with a strength caveat.
5. Infrastructure failures (build failure without acceptable fallback, playwright/chrome failure, server failure) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact failure string; never a scientific negative. status=BLOCKED only if the failure precedes any measurement.

Close/re-scope recommendation (deliverable, written to report.md regardless of direction): if SUPPORTS -> benchmark executable as frozen with the proven driver; if FALSIFIES/MIXED -> readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfiable on the credential-free path; re-scope the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark off the credential-free path: drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor; require internally re-run comparators (same harness, frozen seeds) on a task bank with demonstrable dynamic range (cold and retrieval arms must NOT saturate at 1.0 at high novelty, per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128).
claim_ceiling_rules: The result bounds capability ONLY for the frozen minimal two-step synthetic task, the frozen prompts, the frozen sampling and the measured credential-free candidates. A SUPPORTS licenses readiness condition (3) for this task class; a FALSIFIES/MIXED bounds the credential-free driver set for this task class. No generalization to arbitrary multi-step web tasks; no Product-Core promotion; no claim-status change by this packet.
scope_boundaries: No new endpoint provisioning, Docker/ollama routes, GPU, paid APIs, or human-issued credentials.
No measurement of C-PRODUCT-ECON economics, no kernel promotion, no four-arm benchmark execution (downstream, gated on this result).
No re-litigation of the audited carried negatives (0.5B, Pollinations).
No promotion of any endpoint into Product Core.
Non-Qwen open-weight models (e.g. Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-9B) are out of scope (not obtainable via the confirmed route without new provisioning).

The four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark becomes executable as frozen: same model/tools/budget across COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL, SPIDER arms on a dynamic-range task bank. control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared expected outcome and a pre-declared failure meaning (spec.control_registry): PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE must return 5/5 and can fail if the page/verifier is broken (certifies the ceiling at 1.0); PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING must return 10/10 and can fail on broken grammar/build (isolates decoding); NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION must return 0 parseable/0 success (verifier rejects non-actions); B-RANDOM-ACTION must return chance-level success (verifier does not accept chance); CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION must reproduce 0/5 + loop and can fail if the harness/environment drifts.
